description.text:
Company Overview
Jervois Plus is a Hong Kong-based multimedia production team that offers media and technical consulting. We are looking for talents to work with our joint company, Pacific Meta, to develop their product that will be widely used in medical and hospital training.
Pacific Meta is a technology company focused on developing training games and serious games that transform professional training into engaging, interactive learning experiences.
Our products are primarily used in healthcare, caregiving, and professional skills training, allowing learners to practice real-world procedures through simulation-based scenarios in a safe and repeatable environment. By combining game design with practical training needs, we help users build confidence and improve performance effectively.
We believe effective training goes beyond delivering information—it enables people to truly learn by doing. Pacific Meta works closely with professional institutions to create training solutions that balance accuracy, usability, and learning impact.
https://www.pacificmeta.io/index.php
YOUR MISSION
- Develop medical education game-related system features using Unity.
- Participate in project development, subsequent updates, and maintenance.
- Design and write flexible, highly maintainable C# code.
- Customize backend systems according to the requirements of different medical institutions.
- Provide necessary technical documentation and professional support for projects.
- Communicate directly with the game lead, requiring proficiency in English communication.
YOUR HEROIC SKILLS
- Degree in Computer Science, Game Design, or related field, or equivalent self-taught experience.
- At least 1 year of Unity development experience (including school projects or personal work).
- Proficient in C# programming fundamentals.
- Portfolio of 1–2 showcase-worthy Unity projects.
- Familiarity with the basic functions of the Unity engine.
- Basic UI design and implementation skills.
- Proficient with version control tools such as Git.
- Strong teamwork and cross-departmental communication skills.
- Creative thinking and problem-solving abilities.
- Willingness and ability to learn independently and adapt to new challenges.
NICE TO HAVE
- Interest in interactive content for medical or educational applications.
- Basic knowledge of Unreal Engine or TouchDesigner.
- Basic understanding of 3D modeling and animation.
- Familiarity with visual design and user experience fundamentals.
- Basic understanding of multi-platform deployment (web, mobile).
- Experience participating in a complete project development cycle.
- Experience in software testing or backend system integration.
- Open-minded and curious about emerging technologies.
